# Azure Health Data Services

Unify and manage health data and protected health information (PHI) in the cloud.

  [Get started with Azure](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/purchase-options/azure-account) [Create a pay-as-you-go account](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/purchase-options/pay-as-you-go)

 ![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/bg-acom-fl-lg-bh-all-3?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=1600&amp;hei=1038&amp;qlt=100&amp;fmt=png-alpha&amp;fit=constrain)

Overview

## Build, manage, and analyze health data on Azure

-  

    ### Improve patient and research outcomes with analytics and insights

  Azure Health Data Services is a suite of purpose-built technologies for protected health information (PHI) in the cloud. It's built on the global open standards Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)® and Digital Imaging Communications in Medicine (DICOM). Ensure data privacy within compliance boundaries, de-identify data for secondary use, and generate insights with analytics and AI tools.

   ![Person interacting with a large digital world map displayed on a transparent screen.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-01-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1282&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### The evolution of Azure API for FHIR

  Azure Health Data Services is the evolved version of Azure API for FHIR and offers additional technology and services. Existing customers can continue using the product without disruption to service or change in pricing structure.

   ![Medical professionals reviewing patient data on multiple monitors in a clinical workspace.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-02-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### Streamline health workloads

  Unify healthcare data in the cloud to make PHI easier to exchange across the care continuum. Standardize diverse data streams such as clinical, imaging, device, and unstructured data using FHIR, DICOM, and MedTech services.

   [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2218601&clcid=0x409)

   ![Medical workstation displaying diagnostic data and imaging results on dual screens.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-03-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### Gain insights from PHI data in real time

  Prepare standardized data for advanced AI and machine learning applications and create cohorts for clinical research and trials. Connect to Power BI and Azure Synapse Analytics for visualizations and analytics, use SMART on FHIR apps to build new applications, and apply machine learning to create new algorithms for diagnosis assistance and research.

   [Analyze FHIR data with Azure Synapse Analytics](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2218009&clcid=0x409)

   ![Clinical team analyzing medical scans and patient information across several monitors.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-04-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### Build on a trusted cloud for healthcare

  Azure Health Data Services is HITRUST CSF certified, which helps organizations store PHI in accordance with HIPAA and GDPR requirements and meet ONC and CMS mandates. Control access of health data with application monitoring and role-based access controls within a compliance boundary.

   [Learn about CMS patient access rule](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2218503&clcid=0x409)

   ![Laptop on a desk displaying analytics and performance charts next to a mouse and smart speaker.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-05-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### Decentralize clinical trials with remote monitoring

  Move from reactive to proactive care for better patient outcomes and experiences. Use the MedTech service to ingest high-frequency biometric data from devices, including wearables. Standardize that data into FHIR to view in context with other clinical datasets. Enable remote monitoring of patients with chronic diseases, accelerate decentralized clinical trials, and allow patients access to virtual care.

   [Learn how Humana monitors patients remotely](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/updates/additional-azure-regions-for-iot-connector-for-azure-api-for-fhir-preview/#:~:text=Azure%20IoT%20Connector%20for%20FHIR%20%28IoT%20Connector%29%2C%20a,West%2C%20West%20Europe%2C%20and%20West%20US%202%20regions.)

   ![Doctor talking to patient](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-06-ACOM-Accordion-800x513?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

-  

    ### Process imaging data quickly and at scale

  Streamline radiology and digital pathology workflows with DICOM cast technology. Manage, store, query, retrieve, and exchange DICOM files in the cloud. Query metadata across clinical and imaging records to reduce time to diagnosis. Process medical imaging data into research cohorts quickly and at scale.

   [Read about the Medical Imaging Server for DICOM](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2217854&clcid=0x409)

   ![Researchers reviewing and discussing a brain scan displayed on a large interactive screen in a library or research workspace.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/3526163-07-ACOM-Accordion?resMode=sharp2&amp;op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&amp;wid=2000&amp;hei=1283&amp;qlt=100&amp;fit=constrain)

## Plan ahead with simple, transparent pricing

-  

  No upfront costs or surprises—pay for only what you need.

-  

  Azure Health Data Services pricing is based on structured storage used, provisioned throughput, and service runtime.

-  

  Existing Azure API for FHIR customers can continue using the product without disruption to service or change in pricing structure.

## Frequently asked questions

Expand all

Collapse all

-  

   01/

   ### What’s the difference between Azure Health Data Services and Azure API for FHIR?

  Azure Health Data Services has evolved to support multiple health data standards for the exchange of structured data. A single collection of APIs allows you to deploy multiple data service instances of different service types (FHIR, DICOM, and IoT Connector) that work seamlessly with one another.

-  

   02/

   ### What is HL7 FHIR?

  HL7 FHIR, or Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources, is an open-standard data model that enables data interoperability for systems using FHIR. [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2218409).

-  

   03/

   ### What is DICOM?

  Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) is the standard for the communication and management of medical imaging information and related data. DICOM is most commonly used for storing and transmitting medical images enabling the integration of medical imaging devices such as scanners, servers, workstations, printers, and network hardware.

-  

   04/

   ### What is the de-identification service?

  The Azure Health Data Services de-identification service is a cloud-based API service that applies state-of-the-art machine learning models to automatically extract, redact, or surrogate protected health information (PHI) entities—including HIPAA’s 18 PHI identifiers – from unstructured text such as clinical notes, transcriptions, messages, or clinical trial studies.

-  

   05/

   ### What is the pricing of Azure Health Data Services?

  Detailed pricing information is available on [the pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/).

-  

   06/

   In what regions is Azure Health Data Services available?

   [See the Azure regions where Azure Health Data Services is available](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/explore/global-infrastructure/products-by-region/?products=health-data-services).
